rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=1024, gs_n_iter=130, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=False, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.0, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-3 (search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB (capacity): gs_n_gaussians 512->1024. gs_n_iter set to 130 (down from 220) ONLY to keep the per-scene cost in budget at 2x Gaussians (1024 Gaussians ~506 ms/step -> 130 steps x 15 scenes ~987 s < 1080 in-solver wall < 1200 HARD); this is NOT a second free knob because the step axis is already proven SATURATED -- iter-1 (150 steps) SSIM 0.8032 vs iter-2 (220 steps) SSIM 0.8048 = +0.0016 FLAT, so any step count >=130 gives the same per-scene quality. The isolated variable is therefore CAPACITY. PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-1 hr=0 SSIM 0.8032 (512 G/150 it), iter-2 hr=0 SSIM 0.8048 (512 G/220 it, quality lever REFUTED flat), both recon PSNR ~20.2 vs 128-view FBP baseline PSNR 35.97 -> hr=0. All 15/15 scenes completed. FAILURE MODE: the 512-Gaussian anisotropic mixture is too COARSE a basis to represent dense breast soft tissue -> saturates near SSIM 0.80, far below the strong sparse-FBP baseline (documented ceiling, findings 2026-06-03). HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): if doubling the basis (512->1024 Gaussians) lifts SSIM materially above 0.8048 / RMSE below 0.03172, capacity is the binding limiter and more splats help. FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays ~0.80 flat (or drops), the basis-coarseness ceiling is confirmed as capacity-insensitive in this budget -- 1024 splats still land far below the FBP floor on PSNR/RMSE (hr=0). Prior findings (1024 G at 10k-40k iters -> hr=0) predict FLAT. val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT (gs_outer_wall_s=1080). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.8032 (512G) -> iter-2 0.8048 (512G, +steps flat) -> iter-3 capacity test at 1024G., gs_outer_wall_s=1080
